The current consumers in the diff use it in truthiness checks (e.g., `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED)` and `if (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && ...)`), so no immediate runtime defect is shown, but the exported name/contract implies a boolean and could lead to mis-gating if a consumer later does a strict boolean check or relies on boolean typing.
